scenes.narration: In 1989, one press-conference answer opened the Berlin Wall. To see how, start with a note.
scenes.main_point: Show the real press-conference photograph as a sticker with the date stamp
scenes.visual_objective: Show the real press-conference photograph as a sticker with the date stamp

scenes.narration: Spokesman Günter Schabowski has just been handed it.
scenes.main_point: Show Schabowski's own note as a taped sticker
scenes.visual_objective: Show Schabowski's own note as a taped sticker

scenes.narration: Asked when it starts, he says: immediately, without delay. West German news tells viewers the borders are open.
scenes.main_point: Show his answer as a giant quotation and the evening's timed events
scenes.visual_objective: Show his answer as a giant quotation and the evening's timed events

scenes.narration: That night, guards at Bornholmer Straße let people through. A wall that stood for decades opened on one unprepared answer.
